title: Research Assistant hardcoded QE 10 loop example misleads prompts and task cards
description: Research Assistant used to contain fixed QE 10 loop examples in prompt/card/frontend surfaces, causing capability inquiries or draft requests to look as if 10 loops were the default target. The fix moved the assistant to intent-gated dialogue governance: loop count now comes only from explicit user input, runtime configuration or audited context, and ordinary capability/status/concept turns do not select QE workflow branches or action proposals.
reproduce_command: rg -n "QE 10 loop|generate 10 loops|10 loop target|create a QE 10 loop|cardText\(" backend/services backend/tests frontend/src/app/research-assistant frontend/src/lib/research-assistant frontend/tests/research-assistant configs/research_assistant prompt_packs/research_assistant/main
required_verification: Static scan confirms active Research Assistant prompt/config/frontend/runtime paths no longer contain fixed QE 10 loop defaults or appended cardText workflow boilerplate.
Backend tests confirm capability inquiry, concept/status turns and ambiguous requests do not trigger QE workflow prompt branches or action proposals.
Frontend Playwright tests confirm the main chat answer stays readable and does not append raw plan/confirmation/payload details.
BUG JSON and GitHub issue #177 are synchronized with fix commit, validation evidence and production gates.
closure_requirements: Default prompt and human-card templates do not hardcode 10 loop as a QE target.
Loop/iteration count is sourced from user input, runtime config or audited context rather than a prompt example.
Capability or status questions do not start QE planning/preflight/execution workflow by keyword alone.
Validation evidence records static scans, backend tests, frontend E2E and production gates.

events.note: User confirmed that 10 loop was only a design example and must not become a fixed assistant prompt.
